content: Tailwind CSS v4.3.3 is current stable. v4 is production-ready but requires Safari 16.4+/Chrome 111+/Firefox 128+. v3 not the latest. v4 config moves to CSS @theme block (no tailwind.config.js). PostCSS plugin is @tailwindcss/postcss (4.3.3). In globals.css: @import 'tailwindcss'. Design tokens as CSS custom properties inside @theme {}. shadcn/ui fully supports v4 with updated components.
